title: SSH Password Authentication Enabled
description: SSH server supports both publickey and password authentication methods. Password auth enables brute-force attacks.
risks: Credential brute-force attacks could compromise the host if weak passwords exist.
attack_vectors: Use hydra or medusa to brute-force SSH credentials. Combine with email recon (ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com) for targeted attacks.
proof_of_existence: ssh-auth-methods: Supported authentication methods: publickey, password
remediation: Disable PasswordAuthentication in sshd_config, use key-based auth only.

title: SSH Supports Weak HMAC-SHA1 Algorithms
description: SSH server offers hmac-sha1 and hmac-sha1-etm@openssh.com MAC algorithms. SHA-1 is cryptographically deprecated.
risks: Theoretical downgrade attacks could force use of weaker MAC algorithms during SSH session establishment.
attack_vectors: Attempt SSH connection forcing hmac-sha1 MAC algorithm. Combined with MITM position, could weaken integrity protection.
poc: nmap -p 22 --script ssh2-enum-algos 76.13.46.223 -> mac_algorithms includes hmac-sha1, hmac-sha1-etm
proof_of_existence: mac_algorithms: hmac-sha1-etm@openssh.com, hmac-sha1 — both deprecated SHA-1 based MACs offered
remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 and hmac-sha1-etm from MACs directive in sshd_config.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header on HTTP Port 80
description: HTTP port 80 lacks X-Frame-Options header. HTTPS port 443 correctly sets SAMEORIGIN. HTTP endpoint vulnerable to clickjacking.
risks: Clickjacking attacks possible if HTTP endpoint serves framed content before redirect to HTTPS.
attack_vectors: Craft iframe embedding http://cyberian-defenses.com page. Potential UI redressing before redirect occurs.
poc: nikto -h http://cyberian-defenses.com -> 'The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present.'
proof_of_existence: Nikto HTTP: 'The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present.' Nikto HTTPS: 'x-frame-options found with SAMEORIGIN'
remediation: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN to nginx server block for port 80.

title: CSP Allows unsafe-inline for Scripts and Styles
description: Content-Security-Policy includes 'unsafe-inline' in both script-src and style-src directives, weakening XSS mitigation.
risks: XSS attacks can inject inline scripts bypassing CSP. If input validation fails, CSP won't block execution.
attack_vectors: Inject inline <script> payload via any form input (e.g., formspree contact form). CSP won't block inline execution.
poc: nikto -h https://cyberian-defenses.com -> CSP: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' cdn.tailwindcss.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
remediation: Replace unsafe-inline with nonce-based or hash-based CSP directives for scripts and styles.

title: No WAF Detected on Target
description: No WAF signatures or filtering detected in any tool output. Nuclei, Nikto, Wapiti scans ran without interception or blocking.
risks: No rate-limiting or attack filtering means all requests reach the origin server directly.
attack_vectors: Direct exploitation without WAF evasion needed. Brute-force, injection, and scanning can proceed unfiltered.
poc: nuclei 6831 templates + nikto 6544 items + wapiti scan all completed without WAF blocking
proof_of_existence: No WAF headers, no block pages, no rate-limiting observed across all scans. All tools completed fully.
remediation: Deploy Cloudflare or ModSecurity WAF in front of nginx for attack filtering.

title: TLS Configuration Strong — No Vulnerabilities Found
description: TLS config is robust: SSLv2/3/TLS1.0/1.1 disabled, only TLS 1.2/1.3. All ciphers grade A. Not vulnerable to Heartbleed, Poodle, CCS injection. HSTS enabled with 2-year max-age and preload.
risks: No TLS-level risks identified. Certificate is valid (Let's Encrypt, ECDSA-256, expires 2026-10-23).
attack_vectors: No known TLS attack vectors apply.
poc: sslscan + nmap ssl-enum-ciphers: all A-grade, no legacy protocols, no known vulns
proof_of_existence: SSLv2 disabled, SSLv3 disabled, TLSv1.0 disabled, TLSv1.1 disabled, TLSv1.2 enabled, TLSv1.3 enabled. least strength: A. HSTS: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload
remediation: Maintain current configuration. Monitor for cert renewal (expires Oct 2026).

title: Nuclei Scan Found Zero Vulnerabilities (6831 Templates)
description: Nuclei v3.11.0 with 6831 templates (latest v10.4.7) scanned both HTTP and HTTPS endpoints. No findings at low/medium/high/critical severity.
risks: No template-matched vulnerabilities detected. Note: depth limited without directory enumeration or authenticated scans.
attack_vectors: N/A — no vulns found. Deeper content testing (JS analysis, CMS detection on /blog/) needed.
proof_of_existence: Templates loaded: 6831. Both HTTP and HTTPS scans completed with empty stdout (no findings).
remediation: Run authenticated nuclei scans and custom templates for /blog/ CMS if discovered.
